fine_trace.note: When a '.' is encountered, hasIp4 is set and endp is reduced by 4 (to mFields.m8 + 11), then the main loop breaks.

The :: expansion loop copies bytes from dst down to colonp+1 into endp downward. With endp already reduced to mFields.m8 + 11 by the IPv4 path, the loop writes past the start of the buffer (underflow) when dst is far past colonp.

Each iteration writes one byte at *endp. When endp has been reduced by the IPv4 handling and dst is at mFields.m8 + 15 with colonp at mFields.m8 - 1, the loop runs 16 times and writes to mFields.m8[-1] through mFields.m8[-4], which is a stack-buffer write outside the 16-byte address object.
After the :: expansion, the IPv4 parsing resets dst and endp, but the out-of-bounds writes from the :: expansion have already occurred.
